rule: CampaignGraphValidator refuses a staged generated campaign with any diagnostic, before it registers; the codes are its diagnostic classes (graph.*); a refusal is never retryable on its own (it is a factory or policy defect, not a seed)

dispositions.dissolved: MMR-31: a realm with no town after the compiler and travel exclusions, and its clans
dispositions.bounded: MMR-32: a source hero beyond the bound the roster policy keeps
dispositions.notInstantiated: MMR-27/32: a source hero the compiler or the hero factory does not instantiate

pendingRuntime: W05: runtime settlement, gate and port positions on the generated scene and its navigation mesh (not checked here)
U03: runtime route reachability between generated settlements (not checked here)

codes.graph.malformed_input: a staged document without a root, a record element or component without an id, or a disposition, id-map entry, exclusion or slot without its keys
codes.graph.reference_type: a reference naming an object of another type than its property holds
codes.graph.disposition: a disposition that is not a policy outcome, gives no reason, or contradicts a staged object
codes.graph.source_mismatch: a staged record that disagrees with its compiler record (kind, village binding, port)
codes.graph.unknown_type: a staged record of an element with no supported or registered object type
codes.graph.unknown_object: a staged record that is neither generated (world prefix), a world alias nor a permitted re-emitted template
codes.graph.unexpected_vanilla: an installed Calradia settlement, clan, kingdom or hero, or the character of a Calradia hero, staged in the generated world
codes.graph.official_reference: a reference to an installed Calradia world instance (or hero character) the world does not stage; world aliases count only when staged
codes.graph.malformed_reference: a reference value the installed loaders cannot parse
codes.graph.unresolved_reference: a reference resolving to nothing staged, installed or verified as a live default
codes.graph.ownership: a kingdom without its ruler, ruling clan or capital; a clan without its leader; a fief without an owner
codes.graph.hero_role: a hero without its hero character or clan; a ruler, clan leader or noble clan member who is not a Lord
codes.graph.settlement_component: a settlement without exactly one component of a supported kind, the location complex every installed settlement of its kind has, or its village type
codes.graph.village_binding: a village not bound to a town or castle of the world
codes.graph.port: a port town without a shipyard, or a shipyard without a town port
codes.graph.troop_upgrade: a cycle in the upgrade tree of a character the world stages or reaches
codes.graph.party_intent: a clan with lords but no fortified home, a bandit clan without a home, a runtime hero without an installed template of its occupation or a home of its kind, a runtime relation to no hero of the world
codes.graph.fixed_position: a settlement, start point or spawn position at an installed Calradia coordinate (settlement, gate, port or start point)
codes.graph.silent_discard: a compiler record with neither a generated object nor an explicit disposition
codes.graph.pending_slot: a compiler slot still pending whose owner is delivered (or not deferred), or claimed resolved while the staged graph lacks it
codes.graph.policy_identity: a resolving policy or required inventory missing from the identity snapshot
